versions.name: Energy
versions.description: Trace energy through the systems you use every day, run a two-week audit of your household, chart where the country's power comes from, and compare how solar, nuclear, wind, and fossil plants are being improved.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
